message.content:
Mock canned response for the aiZipDemo workflow.

This content stands in for all three of the demo's ai_call tasks (STL random fact / Python trivia / Vulkan method).  Each task receives this same body — workflow-shape correctness is what's verified by the demo, not content variation.  The downstream `zip_responses` shell task packages the three .output.txt files into a single archive, exercising the dataflow + shell-task path end-to-end without burning real provider credit.

If you need three distinct canned responses (one per ai_call task) for richer demo content, provision three separate mock interfaces in `config.json` — each with `is_mock: true` and its own `fixture_path` — and reference them by name from the per-task `params.provider` field in the JCWF.
